intent: A/B test zswap against the 32 GiB zram setup with a seeded memory-pressure benchmark, in vmbox and on the host; keep the winner (zram) as the host default, with each setup script the one-command switch to its setup.
scope: linux_configuration/fixes: setup_zswap.sh (new), setup_zram.sh (now also the revert), swap_bench.sh (new), lib/swap_switch.sh (new), DOCS-zswap-vs-zram.md + swap-bench-results.tsv (results)
python_pkg/swap_bench: seeded workload, row parsing, medians + winner rule
Swap-setup-aware wording in lib/arch_sysctl.sh, lib/arch_perf_probes.sh, optimize_arch_desktop.sh; swappiness stays 100
Non-goal: hibernation config (resume= stays on /swapfile), swapfile priorities
changes: setup_zswap.sh persists zswap.enabled=1 zstd max_pool_percent=35 shrinker on every systemd-boot entry (or GRUB + grub-mkconfig), removes the zram-generator conf, switches live (swapoff zram0 first, zswap on after) or exits 3 'reboot to apply' when MemAvailable cannot absorb zram
setup_zram.sh restores zswap.enabled=0, reinstalls the conf (ZRAM_SIZE_MIB scales it for a small guest), starts zram0, then turns zswap off live

swap_bench.sh run host|vm: one seeded run per call in a MemoryMax=4G/MemorySwapMax=infinity scope (host) or system-wide (vm); records ratio, PSI some/full, major faults, disk writeback (pswpout minus zram writes), zswpwb, desktop session PSI; refuses a host run when MemAvailable < cap + 2G; summary applies the PSI-full / major-fault / 10 % rule
check_memory_pressure advice names the installed swap setup (zram, zswap or plain disk)

verification.evidence: 45 passed, 0 failed: live switch both ways, three loader entries, GRUB, exit 3, idempotent reruns byte-identical, grub-mkconfig failure loud
27 passed: scope properties, same seed same CRCs, refusals record no row, low-RAM guard, summary
every phase OK: live switch both ways, persistence after reboot, reruns unchanged, exit 3 then next boot on zswap

verification.command: vm wake zswh -- 'rtcwake -m no -s 60 && systemctl hibernate' (guest booted on the zswap cmdline, 3 GB in the pool)
verification.evidence: verdict hibernate, same boot_id after resume, zswap enabled=Y max_pool_percent=35

verification.command: swap_bench.sh run vm x6, run host x6; swap_bench.sh summary
verification.evidence: vm PSI full 5996 zram vs 10360 zswap; host 7427 vs 8973; winner zram on both; identical CRCs across all 12 runs

verification.command: sudo setup_zswap.sh then sudo setup_zram.sh on the host
verification.evidence: live both ways without reboot; /proc/cmdline zswap.enabled=0, zram0 prio 100, enabled=N, loader entries byte-identical to /var/lib/swap-switch/*.orig

risks: Host benchmark numbers are noisy (other board jobs ran concurrently); the VM run, pressed system-wide, agrees with them
The vmbox guest that ran the benchmarks cold-booted on hibernate under both setups; a fresh guest resumed, cause not found
rollback: sudo linux_configuration/fixes/setup_zram.sh restores the zram setup and zswap.enabled=0 on every loader entry; originals stay in /var/lib/swap-switch/*.orig
After rollback check: cat /proc/cmdline; swapon --show; cat /sys/module/zswap/parameters/enabled
